changelog:
- Initial release of Issue Reporter for Jellyfin
- Resource-efficient O(1) ILoggerProvider with bounded async channel
- Dynamic plugin discovery with FaserF repository defaults & universal custom overrides
- 4-layer secret harvesting, regex scrubbing, custom rules & fail-closed Leak Guard
- ETag-cached GitHub client, anti-spam flood breaker, retry outbox & issue template auto-fill
description: Resource-efficient Jellyfin plugin for plugin developers that monitors plugin logs, masks sensitive data across 4 layers, deduplicates GitHub issues with version intelligence, and auto-fills issue templates.
name: Issue Reporter
overview: Spook-grade automated GitHub issue reporter for Jellyfin plugin developers with 4-layer zero-leak redaction, ETag caching, anti-spam protections, and persistent retry outbox.
